creative_brief.description: 2-3 paragraph synthesis of strategy and market research, framing the creative challenge

mood_board_description.description: Sensory and emotional description of the visual direction (color, texture, energy, materiality)

visual_language_criteria.description: Adjectives and principles guiding visual execution (e.g., 'clean and minimal', 'warm and inviting')

naming_criteria.description: Specific attributes the brand name should embody (e.g., 'memorable', 'conveys partnership', 'domain-available')

tone_of_voice_guidelines.description: How the brand communicates: formality level, emotional register, key linguistic patterns

key_visual_metaphors.description: Metaphors, symbols, or concepts to explore in visual design

brand_voice_examples.description: Sample sentences or phrases in the brand voice

constraints_and_guardrails.description: What to avoid, boundary conditions for creative execution
